@aws-sdk/client-s3.purpose: S3-compatible immutable object storage adapter for source bytes (ADR-002).
@aws-sdk/client-s3.dataBoundary: source bytes and derived artifacts, written to the project-authorized bucket only; no third-party transmission
@aws-sdk/client-s3.replacementPath: any S3-compatible SDK behind ObjectStore in @ivory-tower/adapters

@sentry/node.purpose: Optional server-side error and performance reporting; disabled unless SENTRY_DSN is set.
@sentry/node.dataBoundary: scrubbed operational metadata only; no passage text, source bytes, claims, or researcher notes
@sentry/node.replacementPath: OpenTelemetry exporter behind the same @ivory-tower/infrastructure sentry module

graphile-worker.purpose: PostgreSQL-backed durable job queue (ADR-002 queue boundary).
graphile-worker.dataBoundary: job payloads inside the project database; no external egress
graphile-worker.replacementPath: any durable queue behind JobQueue in @ivory-tower/adapters

pg.purpose: PostgreSQL client for the canonical store and pgvector hybrid search.
pg.dataBoundary: canonical research state inside the project database; no external egress
pg.replacementPath: no realistic substitute; PostgreSQL is a decided dependency (ADR-002)

zod.purpose: Runtime validation of versioned HTTP and job contracts in @ivory-tower/contracts.
zod.replacementPath: any schema validator behind the contract module's exported parsers

tslib.purpose: TypeScript helper runtime required by emitted Theia extension code.

@types/pg.purpose: Type declarations for pg; build-time only, never bundled.

@playwright/test.purpose: Browser test runner for the Ivory health-view smoke test; downloads browsers at install time.
@playwright/test.dataBoundary: test-time only; never shipped in a deployable
@playwright/test.replacementPath: any browser automation runner for examples/ivory-tower-browser tests

@theia/core.purpose: Theia workbench shell (ADR-001). This repository is a source fork of Theia.
@theia/core.dataBoundary: workbench chrome only; Ivory domain state stays behind the IV-18 typed API
@theia/core.replacementPath: none in V1; ADR-001 is a binding platform decision

@theia/filesystem.purpose: Theia filesystem contribution used by the Ivory browser assembly.

@theia/messages.purpose: Theia notification contribution used by the Ivory browser assembly.

@theia/preferences.purpose: Theia preference contribution used by the Ivory browser assembly.

@theia/process.purpose: Theia process contribution required by the browser backend assembly.

@theia/workspace.purpose: Theia workspace contribution used by the Ivory browser assembly.

@theia/cli.purpose: Theia application build and start tooling; build-time only.

@theia/ext-scripts.purpose: Theia per-package build, lint, and test script wrapper; build-time only.

docling.purpose: Docling conversion worker behind the versioned conversion port.
docling.supportedMirror: ghcr.io/docling-project/docling-serve, only after resolving the same v1.21.0 manifest list and recording the mirror digest

postgres.purpose: Local PostgreSQL + pgvector for the development Compose profile.

object-store.purpose: Local S3-compatible object store for the development Compose profile.

object-store-init.purpose: One-shot bucket creation for the local Compose profile.

secretScan.note: Critical patterns are scanned across the whole repository. The remaining patterns are scanned over the Ivory-owned surface only; upstream Theia hygiene is not this gate's subject. Runtime log, telemetry, and audit-shaped redaction is the IV-22 contract in docs/iv-22-deployment-secrets.md.

allowlist.reason: Documented template of empty placeholders and local development defaults; contains no live credential.
Local Compose profile credentials (ivory / ivory-development-only) that never leave a developer machine.
Local runtime verification harness using the same Compose development credentials.
Local Session 04 runtime and migration-recovery verifier using the same Compose development credentials.
Fabricated connection string used to assert that Sentry scrubs database URLs out of event payloads; the test would be meaningless without a password-shaped value.
Environment validation test asserting that a fabricated connection string is rejected before startup.
Profile-contract tests plant non-local postgres URLs to prove staging/production reject local defaults and accept injected secrets.
Adversarial redaction tests plant database URLs and Bearer tokens so the shared redactor is proven, not described.
HTTP 500 test plants a database URL in an thrown Error to prove the generic internal_error body does not echo it.

Adversarial fixture that must contain a credential-shaped assignment so `npm run dependency:policy` can prove the secret scan still rejects it. The value is the fixture's own sentinel, not a credential, and the fixture is scanned under its own policy where nothing is allowlisted.
Declares the sentinel value that the scanner searches for.

dataTerms.note: Model licences and external scholarly-data terms are recorded separately from software licences. A software licence is never authorization to ingest scholarly content (IV-19 professor lens); admission is governed by IV-20/IV-83 and docs/iv-128-content-rights.md.

scholarlyDataTerms.v1Status: safe-open allowlist; per-article licence recorded at admission
safe-open allowlist; approved CC or public-domain terms only

providerTerms.v1Status: no provider SDK is a direct dependency at this commit; IV-87 egress authorization applies before any is added

exceptions.subject: jschardet@2.3.0
exceptions.reason: Encoding detection, inherited transitively from upstream Theia core. Consumed as an unmodified published package and dynamically imported; no LGPL source is modified or statically linked into an Ivory artifact.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: next adopted Theia upstream release, or any change to how the package is bundled
exceptions.compensatingControl: Package and licence text appear in the generated third-party notices; the monthly upstream drift review re-checks the licence expression and bundling mode.

exceptions.subject: @vscode/codicons@0.0.45
exceptions.reason: Icon font shipped in the workbench chrome. CC-BY-4.0 is an attribution licence, not a software licence; the obligation is attribution, which the notices artifact satisfies.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Attribution recorded in the generated third-party notices.

exceptions.subject: busboy@1.6.0
exceptions.reason: Published package metadata omits a license field; confirmed against the registry packument on 2026-08-19. The package ships its licence text in its own LICENSE file, which cannot be read from lockfile metadata alone.

exceptions.compensatingControl: Transitive build/runtime dependency of upstream Theia; recorded in the SBOM and flagged in the notices artifact as licence-unconfirmed.
